```{r read-outcomes}
read_chs_outcomes <- function() {
  read.csv(
    "/Users/fuminli/Desktop/ECG_MRI/csv_train_valid_test_individual_id_disease/CHS_split1.csv",
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    select(
      id,
      prevaf, incaf, ttoaf,
      prevhf, inchf, ttohf,
      prevhfpef, inchfpef, ttohfpef,
      prevhfref, inchfref, ttohfref
    )
}

read_mesa_outcomes <- function() {
  df <- read.csv(
    "/Users/fuminli/Desktop/ECG_MRI/MESA/MESA_disease.csv",
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  names(df)[names(df) == ""] <- "X"

  df %>%
    rename(id = idno_visit) %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    rename_with(~ gsub("pef$", "hfpef", .), ends_with("pef")) %>%
    rename_with(~ gsub("ref$", "hfref", .), ends_with("ref")) %>%
    select(
      id,
      prevaf, incaf, ttoaf,
      prevhf, inchf, ttohf,
      prevhfpef, inchfpef, ttohfpef,
      prevhfref, inchfref, ttohfref
    )
}
```

```{r read-predictions}
read_prediction <- function(cohort_dir, model_dir, label, col_name) {
  path <- file.path(individual_dir, cohort_dir, model_dir, label, "result.csv")
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Missing prediction file: ", path)
  }

  read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(
      id = as.character(id),
      !!col_name := y_pred
    )
}

read_cohort_predictions <- function(cohort, model_specs) {
  cohort_dir <- if (cohort == "CHS") "CHS_zero_shot" else "MESA_zero_shot"
  dir_col <- if (cohort == "CHS") "chs_dir" else "mesa_dir"

  pred_tables <- purrr::pmap(
    model_specs,
    function(model_key, display_name, chs_dir, mesa_dir) {
      model_dir <- if (dir_col == "chs_dir") chs_dir else mesa_dir

      list(
        read_prediction(
          cohort_dir = cohort_dir,
          model_dir = model_dir,
          label = "af5",
          col_name = paste0("af5_", model_key, "_pred")
        ),
        read_prediction(
          cohort_dir = cohort_dir,
          model_dir = model_dir,
          label = "hf5",
          col_name = paste0("hf5_", model_key, "_pred")
        )
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    purrr::flatten()

  purrr::reduce(pred_tables, full_join, by = "id")
}

add_qt <- function(df, cols) {
  out <- df
  for (nm in cols) {
    x <- df[[nm]]
    qs <- quantile(x, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)
    out[[paste0(nm, "_qt")]] <- dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
      x <= qs[1] ~ "low",
      x <= qs[2] ~ "intermediate",
      TRUE ~ "high"
    )
  }
  out
}

build_cohort_data <- function(cohort, model_specs) {
  outcomes <- if (cohort == "CHS") read_chs_outcomes() else read_mesa_outcomes()
  covariates <- if (cohort == "CHS") read_chs_covariates() else read_mesa_covariates()
  predictions <- read_cohort_predictions(cohort, model_specs)

  df <- outcomes %>%
    left_join(covariates, by = "id") %>%
    left_join(predictions, by = "id")

  pred_cols <- c(
    paste0("af5_", model_specs$model_key, "_pred"),
    paste0("hf5_", model_specs$model_key, "_pred")
  )

  add_qt(df, pred_cols)
}
```

```{r fit-hr}
charge_covariates <- c(
  "charge_age",
  "charge_race",
  "charge_height",
  "charge_weight",
  "charge_sbp",
  "charge_dbp",
  "charge_smk",
  "charge_htnmed",
  "charge_dm",
  "charge_prevhf",
  "charge_prevmi"
)

prevent_covariates <- c(
  "prevent_sex",
  "prevent_age",
  "prevent_sbp",
  "prevent_bmi",
  "prevent_egfr",
  "prevent_dm",
  "prevent_smk",
  "prevent_htnmed"
)

set.seed(20260820)

bootstrap_n <- getOption("fig4_bootstrap_n", 10)
bootstrap_ci_probs <- c(0.025, 0.975)

bootstrap_cox_ci <- function(dat, model_formula, coef_names, n_boot = bootstrap_n) {
  boot_log_hr <- replicate(
    n_boot,
    {
      boot_dat <- dat[sample.int(nrow(dat), replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
      fit <- tryCatch(
        coxph(model_formula, data = boot_dat),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (is.null(fit)) {
        return(setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(coef_names)), coef_names))
      }

      coefs <- coef(fit)
      out <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(coef_names)), coef_names)
      matched <- intersect(coef_names, names(coefs))
      out[matched] <- coefs[matched]
      out
    },
    simplify = "matrix"
  )

  boot_hr <- exp(t(boot_log_hr))

  tibble(
    level = c("intermediate", "high"),
    lower = apply(boot_hr, 2, quantile, probs = bootstrap_ci_probs[1], na.rm = TRUE),
    upper = apply(boot_hr, 2, quantile, probs = bootstrap_ci_probs[2], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

fit_one <- function(df, model_col, outcome_base, cohort) {
  time_var <- paste0("tto", outcome_base)
  event_var <- paste0("inc", outcome_base)
  prev_var <- paste0("prev", outcome_base)

  dat <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data[[prev_var]] == 0,
      !is.na(.data[[time_var]]),
      !is.na(.data[[event_var]]),
      !is.na(.data[[model_col]])
    )

  dat[[model_col]] <- factor(
    dat[[model_col]],
    levels = c("low", "intermediate", "high")
  )

  model_formula <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, " == 1) ~ ", model_col))
  coef_names <- paste0(model_col, c("intermediate", "high"))

  fit <- coxph(
    model_formula,
    data = dat
  )
  s <- summary(fit)
  ci <- bootstrap_cox_ci(dat, model_formula, coef_names)

  tibble(
    cohort = cohort,
    model = model_col,
    outcome = outcome_base,
    level = c("intermediate", "high"),
    logHR = s$coefficients[coef_names, "coef"],
    HR = s$coefficients[coef_names, "exp(coef)"],
    n = nrow(dat),
    events = sum(dat[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    left_join(ci, by = "level") %>%
    select(cohort, model, outcome, level, logHR, HR, lower, upper, n, events)
}

fit_one_multivariable <- function(df, model_col, outcome_base, cohort) {
  time_var <- paste0("tto", outcome_base)
  event_var <- paste0("inc", outcome_base)
  prev_var <- paste0("prev", outcome_base)
  adjustment_vars <- if (outcome_base == "af") charge_covariates else prevent_covariates
  model_terms <- c(model_col, adjustment_vars)

  dat <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data[[prev_var]] == 0,
      !is.na(.data[[time_var]]),
      !is.na(.data[[event_var]]),
      !is.na(.data[[model_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(adjustment_vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))

  dat[[model_col]] <- factor(
    dat[[model_col]],
    levels = c("low", "intermediate", "high")
  )

  model_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, " == 1) ~ ",
      paste(model_terms, collapse = " + ")
    )
  )

  fit <- coxph(
    model_formula,
    data = dat
  )
  s <- summary(fit)
  coef_names <- paste0(model_col, c("intermediate", "high"))
  ci <- bootstrap_cox_ci(dat, model_formula, coef_names)

  tibble(
    cohort = cohort,
    model = model_col,
    outcome = outcome_base,
    level = c("intermediate", "high"),
    logHR = s$coefficients[coef_names, "coef"],
    HR = s$coefficients[coef_names, "exp(coef)"],
    n = nrow(dat),
    events = sum(dat[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    left_join(ci, by = "level") %>%
    select(cohort, model, outcome, level, logHR, HR, lower, upper, n, events)
}

format_hr_results <- function(res, model_specs, model_order, model_type) {
  res %>%
    mutate(
      model_type = model_type,
      model_key = str_remove(str_remove(model, "^(af5|hf5)_"), "_pred_qt$"),
      model_group = model_specs$display_name[match(model_key, model_specs$model_key)],
      model_group = factor(model_group, levels = model_order),
      term = factor(
        level,
        levels = c("intermediate", "high"),
        labels = c("Intermediate/Low", "High/Low")
      ),
      score = if_else(str_starts(model, "af5_"), "AF5", "HF5"),
      panel = case_when(
        outcome == "af" ~ "AF",
        outcome == "hf" ~ "HF",
        outcome == "hfpef" ~ "HFPEF",
        outcome == "hfref" ~ "HFREF",
        TRUE ~ outcome
      ),
      panel = factor(panel, levels = panel_order)
    )
}

run_for_cohort <- function(df, cohort, model_specs, model_order, fit_function, model_type) {
  af_models <- paste0("af5_", model_specs$model_key, "_pred_qt")
  hf_models <- paste0("hf5_", model_specs$model_key, "_pred_qt")

  bind_rows(
    purrr::map_dfr(af_models, ~ fit_function(df, .x, "af", cohort)),
    purrr::map_dfr(hf_models, function(model_col) {
      purrr::map_dfr(c("hf", "hfpef", "hfref"), ~ fit_function(df, model_col, .x, cohort))
    })
  ) %>%
    format_hr_results(model_specs, model_order, model_type)
}

chs_rs_data <- build_cohort_data("CHS", rs_model_specs)
mesa_rs_data <- build_cohort_data("MESA", rs_model_specs)

fig4_rs_hr <- bind_rows(
  run_for_cohort(chs_rs_data, "CHS", rs_model_specs, rs_model_order, fit_one, "Univariable"),
  run_for_cohort(mesa_rs_data, "MESA", rs_model_specs, rs_model_order, fit_one, "Univariable")
)

fig4_rs_multivariable_hr <- bind_rows(
  run_for_cohort(chs_rs_data, "CHS", rs_model_specs, rs_model_order, fit_one_multivariable, "Multivariable"),
  run_for_cohort(mesa_rs_data, "MESA", rs_model_specs, rs_model_order, fit_one_multivariable, "Multivariable")
)
```

```{r plot-function}
term_colors <- c(
  "Intermediate/Low" = "#F8766D",
  "High/Low" = "#00BFC4"
)

plot_hr <- function(df, plot_title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = model_group, y = HR, colour = term)) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.45), size = 2.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
      width = 0.15,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.45)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = term_colors) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11.5, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12.5),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Hazard Ratio (vs. low)"
    )
}
```
